",
 "new_string": "def transform(grid):
    # Extract the 8-shape and duplicate it side by side.
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 8]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    shape = [[int(grid[r][c] == 8) for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
    h, w = len(shape), len(shape[0])
    out = [[0] * (2 * w) for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if shape[r][c]:
                out[r][c] = 8
                out[r][c + w] = 8
    return out
",
 "replace_all": false,
 "patch": "",
 "cross_profile": false
}
